summary: Repair the MC-SA-01 migration foreign-key column types proven non-executable on a fresh PostgreSQL database before migration acceptance.
unacceptedMigrationRepairReason: Fresh PostgreSQL execution failed before MC-SA-01 could be accepted as an executable migration because company_id and password-recovery user_id were declared TEXT while their referenced Platform Core keys are UUID. The repair changes only those two foreign-key column types and does not alter business behavior.
